seed: The chain the whole product argument rests on, walked end to end in one sitting: draw an icon, make it a component, and show it on a video timeline, with nothing exported, converted or imported anywhere along the way. It draws two shapes in an ordinary document, turns them into a component, puts that component on the shelf every document shares, opens a recording, and drops the icon onto it at the playhead, where it arrives with an in and an out like anything else on that timeline.

steps.note: Two shapes drawn with the ordinary tools, grouped and made a component called Live Badge. Nothing here knows anything about video
One switch puts it on the shelf every document shares. This is the only step between the two halves of the chain, and it is not an export: the drawing stays a drawing
A recording, open as an ordinary document with a timeline, and the same shelf in the same place with the icon on it. Nothing was imported

THE TEST: the icon is on the film, at the playhead, for three seconds, with a bar of its own on the timeline beside the clip. It is still the component you drew, and editing the original still reaches it
and at the start of the recording it is not there yet, because it has an in and an out like everything else on this timeline
